Base initialization restores model/tokenizer weights and provenance but starts a fresh SFT optimizer/schedule unless an explicit future policy says otherwise. Exact SFT resume restores optimizer, scheduler, versioned SFT loader state, RNG, validation ranking, tracker identity, and cumulative telemetry. Extend checkpoint metadata with a backward-compatible training-stage discriminator and base-checkpoint identity so pretraining cannot resume an SFT checkpoint while model-only generation can load either. Compose the shared optimizer-step, OOM, run, tracker, and checkpoint primitives rather than forking their mechanics. - Typed sft_smoke and single-RTX-3090 configs validate all cross-field token-budget, sequence-length, source, cadence, path, and checkpoint invariants and produce deterministic complete resolved snapshots.

- Training consumes only renderer-derived -1 labels, rejects all-ignored microbatches before forward/backward, preserves the exact total token budget under gradient accumulation, and reuses shared clipping, telemetry, OOM advice, and single-device mechanics.

title: Build a resumable best-fit SFT conversation loader
description:
Implement the deterministic assistant-masked SFT batch loader and bounded best-fit conversation packing used by training and validation.

Plan ticket coverage: SFT-007, SFT-008.

Source of truth: plans/pre-training.md.
design: Accept any finite validated conversation sources and explicit source repeat counts, build a deterministic seeded mixture, and render through the shared chat contract. Pack complete bounded renderings with a stable largest-fitting-first choice inside a finite buffer. A row has max_seq_len + 1 tokens before the x/y shift; use BOS as categorical fill because the tokenizer has no pad token, and mask every fill target with -1. Bound an overlong conversation before it enters the fit buffer using an explicit prefix policy, preserve token/mask alignment, count cropped and zero-supervision skips, and never allow an unfittable item to deadlock the buffer or create an all-ignored training batch. Keep mixture scheduling separate from row packing. Model sources through FiniteSFTSource, local data through InMemorySFTSource, and per-loader composition through SFTMixtureEntry(repeats=...). Persist logical source identities, epoch/RNG state, one mixture cursor, and compact buffered item references in a versioned loader state; deterministically reconstruct source order and cursors rather than serializing redundant derived state.
acceptance_criteria:
- The loader emits contiguous integer x/y tensors of shape (device_batch_size, max_seq_len), shifts every target exactly once, uses only valid token IDs or -1 labels, and never mutates conversations, rendered sequences, or prior batches.
- Stable best-fit tests cover exact fits, multiple candidates, equal-length ties, buffer refill, multi-conversation rows, residual fill, and reproducible seeded mixture ordering with no cross-conversation label misalignment.
- BOS fill and cropped-away positions are ignored with -1; real BOS/control tokens keep their renderer mask semantics, and every emitted training batch contains at least one supervised assistant target.
- Conversations longer than max_seq_len + 1 follow one documented bounded-prefix policy before buffering; crop/skip counts are observable, no item can remain perpetually unfittable, and an all-unsupervised dataset fails instead of yielding NaN-producing batches.
- Train iteration has explicit epoch/step exhaustion behavior, while validation builds a fresh finite deterministic view whose results do not depend on prior train consumption.
- A versioned JSON-safe state_dict/load_state_dict round trip restores source identities, the deterministic source order, cursor, epoch, RNG, and buffered items so resumed batch IDs, masks, and labels exactly match uninterrupted execution without serializing derived schedules or tensors.
- State loading rejects changed tokenizer/source identities, sequence or batch sizes, source repeat counts, unknown versions, malformed RNG/stat state, and out-of-range mixture or buffer locators before mutating live loader state.
- Focused packing/resume tests and cross-cutting batch-shape, x/y-shift, ignore_index, and seed regressions pass on CPU without external data downloads.
notes:
Implemented deterministic weighted best-fit SFT loading with bounded prefix cropping, assistant-only mask preservation, BOS/-1 residual fill, fresh finite validation, stable JSONL source identities, and exact versioned JSON-safe resume state.

Review simplification: isolated deterministic source scheduling and replay in _ConversationMixture; made next_batch a thin collect/materialize/record flow; split transactional state decoding from application; removed redundant serialized mixture permutations and per-source cursors; and reduced buffered checkpoint records to source index, absolute source offset, and verified item identity. The weighted schedule and source cursors are reconstructed from the saved epoch seed and mixture cursor. title: Normalize SmolTalk, MMLU, and GSM8K into the SFT schema
description:
Implement deterministic dataset adapters that map the three planned larger SFT sources into the validated conversation contract.

Plan ticket coverage: SFT-009, SFT-010, SFT-011.

Source of truth: plans/pre-training.md.
design: Put remote acquisition behind a small row-source boundary and keep each adapter responsible only for validating and normalizing its source rows. Pin the initial contracts to HuggingFaceTB/smol-smoltalk train/test, cais/mmlu all auxiliary_train/test, and openai/gsm8k main train/test as represented by karpathy/nanochat commit 92d63d4e8bb4df75c3b71618f31ddde2378b2bcd. Reuse urllib and PyArrow already in the base install to cache auto-converted parquet shards under a versioned, atomic manifest with source identities; do not require the heavyweight datasets package. Use deterministic seeded views and injectable local tables so tests never need the network. Preserve the exact small-model MMLU choice binding format and normalize GSM8K calculator markup to the renderer's typed assistant parts. Mixture weighting and token packing belong to the dependent loader bead.
acceptance_criteria:
- SmolTalk train/test rows normalize their messages exactly, accepting only an optional leading system followed by alternating user/assistant strings and surfacing source row/split context on invalid data.
- MMLU all/auxiliary_train and test rows render four choices deterministically as choice=letter with no whitespace before the letter, request a letter-only answer, and emit the correct A-D assistant response.
- GSM8K main train/test rows preserve ordinary solution text and transform each valid <<expression=result>> segment into ordered python and python_output parts; repeated tool calls, empty text fragments, signed/comma answers, and malformed markers have explicit tested behavior.
- Adapter output passes the shared conversation validator, and composition tests prove GSM8K python calls are supervised while calculator outputs are masked without reimplementing renderer policy.
- Hub parquet discovery, download, and publication use validated repository/subset/split identities plus an atomic completion manifest; partial, corrupt, schema-mismatched, empty, and conflicting cached data fail safely and actionably.
- Bounded slicing and seeded ordering are repeatable across processes, expose stable source identities/counts, and do not load all row dictionaries eagerly.
- Unit and command-level smoke tests use injected local parquet fixtures and make no credential, network, W&B, or GPU calls; the normal base dependency set remains sufficient.
notes:
Implemented exact SmolTalk/MMLU/GSM8K normalization, strict calculator-part parsing, stable source/example identities, bounded seeded parquet iteration, official Hub parquet discovery behind injected boundaries, verified atomic caches, and a local-only/dry-run preparation command.

title: Define validated chat conversations and exact assistant-only rendering
description:
Create the Phase 7 conversation domain contract, tracked tiny JSONL fixtures, and renderer that turns supported conversations into immutable token IDs and aligned supervision masks.

Plan ticket coverage: SFT-001, SFT-002, SFT-003, SFT-004, SFT-005, SFT-006.

Source of truth: plans/pre-training.md.
design: Keep chat semantics in a dedicated SFT/chat package rather than adding renderer methods to concrete tokenizers. Pin local parity fixtures to karpathy/nanochat commit 92d63d4e8bb4df75c3b71618f31ddde2378b2bcd while using the repository's shared Tokenizer contract. Accept an optional leading system message followed by strict user/assistant alternation; system and user content are strings, while assistant content may be a string or typed text, python, and python_output parts needed by the planned GSM8K adapter. Merge a leading system message into the first user message with exactly two newlines without mutating caller data. Render BOS and the existing user/assistant/tool control vocabulary. Supervise assistant text, assistant_end, and assistant-authored python calls plus their python controls; mask BOS, all user spans, assistant_start, python outputs and output controls, and fill. Derive shifted labels with -1 only at the SFT batch boundary because GPT already implements ignore_index=-1. Also expose prompt rendering that ends at assistant_start for later checkpoint generation.
acceptance_criteria:
- A typed, versioned conversation schema and JSONL reader validate non-empty messages, one optional leading system message, strict user/assistant alternation, supported content/part shapes, UTF-8 input, and clear line-numbered errors without mutating decoded records.
- Tracked tiny train and validation JSONL fixtures cover simple, multi-turn, leading-system, Unicode, and assistant tool-part conversations and remain small enough for deterministic CPU tests.
- Exact token-ID fixtures prove BOS and every user, assistant, python, and output delimiter is placed once in the documented order for both ByteTokenizer and a saved RegexBPETokenizer.
- The leading system message is merged into the first user string with exactly two newlines; missing users, misplaced systems, duplicate roles, unknown roles/parts, and invalid content fail before tokenization.
- Token and mask lengths always agree. Only assistant text, assistant_end, python call text, python_start, and python_end are supervised; BOS, user spans, assistant_start, python outputs, output controls, and fill are masked.
- Shifted SFT labels align mask[1:] with next-token targets, use exactly -1 for ignored positions, never mutate renderer output, and retain at least one supervised target or fail explicitly.
- Completion-prompt rendering reuses the same template, preserves prior turns, appends one assistant_start, and adds no fabricated assistant_end.
- Focused schema/rendering tests plus existing tokenizer, model-loss, and package-layout regressions pass without a network or GPU.
notes:
Implemented immutable schema v1 conversation values, strict line-numbered UTF-8 JSONL loading, exact tokenizer-agnostic assistant-only rendering, system-message merging, completion prompting, shifted -1 labels, and tracked train/validation fixtures.

title: Benchmark and document RTX 3090 scaling
description:

Reuse domain telemetry and the offline comparison report; do not recalculate throughput, FLOPs, MFU, or memory in the script. The tuning guide gives exact smoke/tiny/45M commands, artifact expectations, resume/eval/compare workflow, and the OOM reduction order. It explicitly labels Milestone 4 float32 baselines and defers fp16 AMP, GradScaler, activation checkpointing, compile, and FlashAttention to Phase 12.

title: Add BOS-aware document-boundary packing
description:
Add the later document-boundary-aware packing mode on top of the validated tokenized-shard and restartable-loader contracts.

Plan ticket coverage: DATA-013.

Source of truth: plans/pre-training.md.
design: Keep the flat random-offset loader as the educational baseline. The packed strategy consumes validated document spans and shuffles them deterministically. A document first appears as BOS plus source tokens; an oversized document is divided into continuation-aware windows whose prefix is the previous real source token, never an artificial BOS. Continuations start new rows so their prefix cannot follow an unrelated packed document; later complete documents may best-fit into residual space after a continuation. Each ordinary source token is supervised exactly once. A document final token predicts BOS when row capacity permits, and that BOS can open the next packed document. BOS also fills residual/batch padding, so an explicit boolean mask distinguishes supervised content/boundary targets from padding. Standard causal attention remains row-wide. Packing semantics are exact-resume state format v2.
acceptance_criteria:
- The tokenized-storage contract exposes validated document boundaries without changing ordinary token content or invalidating the flat-reader path.
- Packing creates fixed-length next-token examples without losing or duplicating ordinary targets; first windows use BOS and long-document continuations carry the previous real source token as context.
- Complete documents can best-fit after one another, including after a final continuation, with the real final-content-to-BOS boundary supervised and BOS-to-next-content supervised.
- BOS is the only boundary/padding control token; no pad token is introduced, and the explicit boolean loss mask distinguishes real BOS boundary targets from identical BOS-valued padding.
- Standard causal attention remains row-wide and the documentation does not claim per-document attention isolation.
- Seeded ordering and state format v2 resume at the exact next packed batch across shard/epoch boundaries; format v1 fails explicitly because it reconstructs different semantics.
- Hand-built tests cover exact fits, residual space, oversized documents, continuation-plus-next-document packing, Unicode, empty documents, corruption, state compatibility, and flat-versus-packed selection.

title: Add isolated smear and backout experiments
description:
Add the delayed smear and mid-layer backout mechanisms as independently switchable experiments, including exact cached-inference state and rollback behavior.

Plan ticket coverage: ARCH-011.

Source of truth: plans/pre-training.md.
design: Pin placement to nanochat 92d63d4e8bb4df75c3b71618f31ddde2378b2bcd but keep smear and backout independently configurable and off by default. Smear mixes the previous token's normalized embedding into the current position through a bounded channel gate and learnable scalar; full/prefill uses a shift and cached decode stores only the previous pre-smear embedding. Backout snapshots the declared mid-layer residual and subtracts a learnable scaled copy before final norm. Record layer/gate/init choices and do not silently require value embeddings or residual scalars.
acceptance_criteria:
- Independent config states cover neither, smear-only, backout-only, and both; disabled mode adds no experimental parameters/state and preserves baseline logits.
- Hand-computed fixtures verify smear shift/gate/scalar arithmetic without cross-sequence leakage and backout capture/subtraction at the exact declared layer.
- Full, prefill, and cached one-token paths produce matching logits; KVCache reset/failure rollback also clears previous-embedding smear state.
- One-token prompts, batch rows, context cropping, odd/even/one-layer models, dtype/device movement, initialization, gradients, parameter grouping, and checkpoint round-trip are tested.
- Each mechanism and the combined mode pass shape and tiny-overfit tests, and malformed layer/gate settings fail before model mutation.
- Bounded separate and combined comparisons record BPB, training/decode throughput, peak/cache memory, learned scalar/gate summaries, and parameter deltas; reports never attribute the combined result to either mechanism alone.

## Alternatives Considered

- Implement both extensions as required parts of the first web milestone, increasing dependency and single-GPU complexity.

design: The FastAPI/plain-JavaScript harness remains the primary educational implementation. Evaluate each optional extension against duplication, dependency weight, single-3090 residency, checkpoint-switch cost, generation locking, cancellation, metric comparability, and maintenance burden. An accepted Gradio demo must be a thin optional adapter over ChatEngine. Side-by-side comparison must not be smuggled into Milestone 7 without an explicit one-at-a-time or memory-safe execution design. When deferring either item, record the rationale and create only the concrete downstream Beads work needed to preserve it.
acceptance_criteria:
- The Gradio prototype receives an explicit implement-or-defer decision based on educational value and maintenance cost; if implemented, it stays in the demo extra, imports lazily, calls ChatEngine, and is not the main UI.
- Side-by-side checkpoint comparison receives an explicit implement-or-defer decision that addresses one-RTX-3090 memory, sequential versus resident models, matched prompts/seeds/settings, cancellation, and comparable metrics.
- Any implementation reuses the shared engine, renderer, stop set, event schema, generation lease, and transcript/privacy policy; no optional surface may create a second inference path or weaken local-only defaults.
- Any deferral records a durable rationale and a concrete downstream issue/dependency without duplicating WEB ticket ownership or silently making optional work a core Milestone 7 requirement.

title: Benchmark Modal H100 throughput, resume, and projected cost
description: Use the completed single-GPU Modal launcher for a tightly bounded, explicitly authorized H100 validation. Measure the existing 45M training workload, prove checkpoint persistence across invocations, and publish a reproducible comparison with the local RTX 3090 evidence. This task validates orchestration and economics; it does not authorize a full pretraining run.
design: Separate cold start, dependency setup, data attachment, training, checkpoint, and evaluation timings. Reuse the production throughput benchmark and checkpoint contracts. Treat Modal pricing as dated operator-supplied input rather than application configuration or a timeless constant. Persist raw measured results and derive duration and cost projections in a reporting layer. Require explicit user approval immediately before paid execution and enforce a short timeout.
acceptance_criteria:
- Before allocating a GPU, record explicit user authorization, selected GPU, maximum runtime, and maximum estimated spend.
- Upload or otherwise populate the complete current tokenized directory and matching tokenizer artifacts in the read-only input Volume; verify remote paths and identities before GPU work.
- Run the existing bounded small_45m_3090 throughput protocol on one Modal H100 with declared warmup and timed steps.
- Run a short checkpoint-producing pretraining invocation and a second invocation that resumes at the exact next optimizer step from the writable runs Volume.
- Record actual GPU identity, Modal call identity, CUDA and PyTorch versions, Git commit, config, tokenizer and manifest identities, processed tokens, elapsed training time, tokens per second, MFU, peak VRAM, and separate startup or compilation time.
- Save immutable JSON and Markdown comparison artifacts alongside the existing RTX 3090 evidence.
- Project full-run wall time and GPU cost from measured throughput using a dated, explicitly recorded price input; clearly distinguish measurements, arithmetic projections, and uncertainty.
- Keep the bounded validation within the approved runtime and spending cap and do not launch a full 45M, larger-model, or multi-GPU training job.
- Document any H100-specific incompatibility or performance bottleneck as follow-up Beads work rather than silently changing model or training semantics.

title: Benchmark and report inference latency and throughput
